description: User-approved limited return-party surrender, validated against three actual pre-change 96-month saves. Old and new runtimes each acknowledge due reports and advance one real day from the same saved input. This is save continuation evidence, not a fresh campaign balance comparison. Historical fixed-policy long probes are included separately and ran before surrender was implemented.
authorization: User selected Add the limited surrender rule (recommended) on 2026-10-29.

configuration.observation: Decision counters cover each real command. Objective events retain the bounded command trace; dropped events are reported explicitly. Objective/support history records changed states at loop boundaries, not every transient state within a command. History does not establish pre-dispatch donor conditions.
configuration.note: Small scripted player policy using actual capital work, legal orders and actual battle ration remainders. Not a human-play simulation. Passive defense stays home; economy-first waits three months and requires a 1.25 troop ratio and 3000 food left; border attack attempts one ready expedition after day 30.
